user.title: Add a Climado zone
user.description: Pick the thermostat and sensors. Heating is optional, requires Celsius units, and never switches Heat/Aux. Review the Heating configuration temperatures on the Climado device before enabling heating targets. Sleep uses the ecobee Sleep heating setpoint.

init.title: Climado options
init.description: Setpoints and timeouts are Configuration entities on the Climado device. Review the separate Heating temperatures before enabling heating targets. Heating requires Celsius units and preserves your selected Heat/Aux source; it does not provide automatic furnace fallback. Sleep uses the ecobee Sleep comfort setting.

heat_cost.title: Heating cost estimates
heat_cost.description: Advisory only; fuel selection stays manual. Use CAD variable prices on the same tax/rebate basis, excluding fixed monthly charges. Valid-until dates are exclusive. Performance rows must be in increasing outdoor temperature order and describe your matched system. Incomplete settings can be saved; the card will show what is missing. {detail}
